参与调研 · 累计余额 · 兑换回报
en: Take surveys · Earn rewards · Redeem payouts

zh: 参与调研 · 累计积分 · 兑换回报
en: Take surveys · Earn points · Redeem payouts

zh: 当前没有可参与的问卷
提现审核期间不可动用
en: Held while the payout is under review
Pick a survey you qualify for

zh: 广告主把推广任务放在 Moonetix 广告墙上：试用一个应用、看一段演示、注册一个试用账号。 完成一项，广告主付钱，我们按约定比例折成乘法币发给你。奖励由服务商回调入账， 不是前端自己加的——所以到账会晚几十秒，也可能被冲正。
en: Advertisers list their offers on the Moonetix offerwall: try an app, watch a demo, sign up for a trial. Finish one and the advertiser pays, and we convert that into CFB at our standard rate. The reward is credited by the provider's server callback, not by the page itself — so it lands a few seconds late and can be reversed.

zh: 问卷由委托方发布，通过审核后在此处显示。新问卷上线时，站内消息会发出提醒。 符合样本条件的问卷才会出现在列表中，条件不符或名额已满的问卷不显示。
en: Surveys are published by research clients and appear here once approved. You get an in-site message when new ones go live. Only surveys that match your profile are listed — ones you do not qualify for, or that are full, stay hidden.

zh: 当前没有与你的资料匹配的问卷，或本轮名额已经招满。新问卷上线时，站内消息会发出提醒； 补全年龄段、城市与职业等信息后，可匹配的问卷会增加。
en: Nothing matches your profile right now, or this round is full. New surveys trigger an in-site message. Filling in your age range, city and occupation will widen what you match.

zh: 提现申请提交后金额进入冻结，审核通过七个工作日内打款；兑换码类商品即时发放， 订阅类商品由人工在两个工作日内开通，结果通过站内消息通知。
en: Once a payout is requested, the amount is held until it is approved, then paid out within seven business days. Gift codes are issued instantly; subscriptions are activated manually within two business days, and you are notified by in-site message.

zh: 乘法币可提现至支付宝或微信，也可即时兑换数字兑换码。两条路径折算比例一致， 不存在手续费差价，选择哪一种只取决于用途。
en: CFB can be withdrawn to Alipay or WeChat, or spent instantly on digital codes. Both routes use the same rate with no fee spread — which one you pick only depends on what you need.

zh: 1 乘法币折 1 元人民币、1 乘法刀折 1 美元，两者数值相同，可点导航栏余额后的币种切换；提现与兑换码采用同一比例，不额外收取手续费。
en: 1 CFB = 1 CNY and 1 CF$ = 1 USD, same number either way. Use the currency switch next to your balance in the top bar. Withdrawals and gift codes use the same rate and carry no extra fee.

zh: 墙由第三方托管，在你的账号名下展开任务列表；同一个账号 ID 每次打开都是同一个人， 所以奖励不会串号。
en: The wall is hosted by a third party and opens under your account ID, so every visit is recognised as the same person and rewards never go to the wrong account.

zh: 广告主要先校验任务有没有真的完成，通常几十秒到几分钟。刚做完没看到余额变化，先等一会儿。
en: The advertiser verifies the task first, which usually takes from tens of seconds to a few minutes. If the balance has not moved right away, give it a moment.

zh: 如果任务被判定无效（卸载太快、资料造假），服务商会发一条冲正回调，已发的奖励会被扣回。
en: If a task is judged invalid — uninstalled too fast, fake details — the provider sends a reversal callback and the reward is taken back.

zh: 走 VPN、代理、机房网络的用户会被广告墙直接拦掉，这是服务商的规则，不是本站的限制。
en: Users on VPNs, proxies or data-centre networks are blocked by the offerwall itself. That is the provider's rule, not a limit we imposed.

zh: 问卷收益来自委托方支付的调研费用，平台不设邀请返利与层级分成，也不存在先交费后接单。
en: Survey rewards come from research fees paid by clients. There are no referral kickbacks, no multi-level cuts, and nothing to pay before you start.

zh: 任务由第三方广告主发布，本站只做展示与结算。遇到不到账，带上交易号提交工单查。
en: Tasks are published by third-party advertisers; we only display them and settle the payout. If a reward is missing, open a ticket with the transaction ID.

zh: 登录或注册乘法账户。创建账户后可浏览公开问卷，参与市场调研并累积积分。
en: Sign in or create a Chengfa account. Once you are in, you can browse public surveys, take part and accumulate points.

zh: 忘了密码？到「联系客服」提交工单，注明注册邮箱，由站长核对后重置。
en: Forgot your password? Open a ticket under Contact Support with your registered email, and the site owner will verify and reset it.

zh: 还没有广告墙记录。完成第一项任务后，这里会出现交易号、面额与状态。
en: No offerwall activity yet. Your first completed task will show up here with its transaction ID, amount and status.

zh: 提现申请提交时，对应金额从可用余额划入冻结，审核驳回则原路退回。
en: When a payout is requested, the amount moves from available to held. If it is rejected, it goes straight back.

zh: 每一笔收入与支出都记入收支明细，可逐笔核对，出现差异用单号追溯。
en: Every credit and debit is written to your ledger, so you can check line by line and trace any difference by its reference ID.

zh: 答卷经有效性与完整性核验，通过即计入余额，可在收支明细中查到。
en: Responses are checked for validity and completeness, then credited to your balance and listed in the ledger.

zh: 问卷收益来自委托方支付的调研费用，平台不设邀请返利与层级分成。
en: Survey rewards come from fees paid by research clients. No referral kickbacks, no multi-level splits.

zh: 兑换码即时发放；提现经人工审核后七个工作日内到账，节假日顺延。
en: Gift codes are issued instantly. Payouts are reviewed manually and arrive within seven business days, later across public holidays.

zh: 乘法赚积分：在广告墙完成第三方任务，奖励经服务端回调入账。
en: Chengfa · Earn: complete third-party offers on the wall, rewards credited by server callback.

zh: 年龄段、城市与职业决定可参与的问卷范围，缺项会错过匹配。
en: Age range, city and occupation decide which surveys you match. Missing fields mean missed matches.

zh: 每份问卷标注题目数量、预计耗时与奖励额度，开始后可暂存。
en: Each survey lists its question count, expected time and reward. You can pause after starting.

zh: 登录状态保持 30 天。在公共设备上使用后请退出。
en: Sessions last 30 days. Sign out after using a shared device.

zh: 本站为个人独立项目，广告墙任务由第三方广告主提供。
en: This site is an independent personal project. Offerwall tasks are supplied by third-party advertisers.

zh: 乘法问卷大厅：查看可参与的调研问卷与奖励额度。
en: Chengfa Survey Hall: browse surveys you qualify for and see what they pay.

zh: 服务端用你的 UID 和签名盐生成一次性链接
en: The server builds a one-time link from your UID and the signing salt

zh: 价格与库存实时读取，兑换后立即进入兑换记录。
en: Prices and stock are read live; redemptions appear in your history immediately.

zh: 答卷经有效性与完整性核验，通过即计入余额。
en: Responses are verified for validity and completeness, then credited to your balance.

zh: 年龄段、城市与职业决定可参与的问卷范围。
en: Age range, city and occupation set the surveys you qualify for.

zh: 乘法账户中心。查看余额、等级与问卷入口。
en: Your Chengfa account: balance, level and survey entry points.

zh: 用于找回账号和接收通知，不会公开显示。
en: Used for account recovery and notifications. Never shown publicly.

zh: 列表标注题目类型、预计耗时与积分额度。
en: The list shows question type, expected time and reward.

zh: 乘法兑换中心：乘法币提现与数字兑换码。
en: Chengfa Redeem: cash out CFB or spend it on digital codes.

zh: 使用注册时填写的邮箱与密码进入账户。
en: Sign in with the email and password you registered with.

zh: 暂时没有可兑换的商品，稍后再来看看。
en: Nothing to redeem right now — check back later.

zh: 忘了用户名的话，填注册邮箱也能登。
en: Forgot your username? Your registered email works too.

zh: 站长从当前开放的问卷里挑出来的几份
en: A few picks from the surveys currently open

zh: 校验签名与交易号，重复只入一次
en: Signature and transaction ID checked; duplicates credited once

zh: 个人简介，点击编辑，回车保存
en: Your bio — click to edit, Enter to save

zh: 广告主确认后，服务商回调本站
en: Provider calls back once the advertiser confirms
, where the earning and payout rules are explained.
Tap to complete the human check

zh: 有。账户里的「赚积分」页接入了一个广告墙，任务由第三方广告主发布——试用一个应用、看一段演示、 注册一个试用账号，完成后按面额计入积分。这类奖励由服务商回调本站入账，所以会有几十秒到几分钟的延迟； 任务被判定无效时也会被冲正扣回。
en: Yes. The Earn page connects to an offerwall where third-party advertisers post tasks: try an app, watch a demo, sign up for a trial. Finish one and it is credited at its face value. These rewards arrive through the provider's server callback, so there is a delay of tens of seconds to a few minutes, and invalid tasks are reversed.

zh: 可以。积分对应委托方已支付的调研费用，并非平台自行发行。十元提现门槛的设置原因在于， 低于该金额的转账手续费与金额本身接近，对双方均不经济。每笔积分的来源、对应问卷与发放时间， 均可在「积分明细」中查询。
en: Yes. Points represent research fees the client has already paid, not currency the platform issues. The 10 CNY payout minimum exists because below that amount the transfer fee approaches the sum itself, which is uneconomic for both sides. Every point's origin, source survey and payout time is listed in the ledger.

zh: 判定标准共三项：全部题目选择同一选项、作答时间显著短于正常阅读所需时间、答案与前序筛选题相互矛盾。 判定无效后将扣回该份问卷的积分并记录原因。如对判定结果有异议，可在积分明细中提交申诉，由人工复核。
en: There are three criteria: identical answers to every question, a completion time far shorter than it takes to read the survey, or answers that contradict earlier screening questions. Invalid responses have their points clawed back with the reason recorded. If you disagree, open a ticket from the ledger and a human will review it.

zh: 多数问卷耗时三至十五分钟，收益依据题目数量与调研难度确定，通常折合人民币数元至二十元。 问卷长度与收益不必然正相关，部分样本稀缺的短问卷单价更高。列表页会标注预计耗时与积分额度。
en: Most surveys take three to fifteen minutes, with rewards set by question count and research difficulty, usually a few CNY up to twenty. Length and reward do not always track each other — some short surveys pay more because the sample is scarce. The list shows expected time and reward for each one.

zh: 品牌方与研究机构需要真实用户的反馈，并为此支付调研费用。完成一份时长三至十五分钟的问卷即可获得相应积分。 积分累计至标准额度后可提现至支付宝或微信，亦可兑换数字兑换码。
en: Brands and research firms need feedback from real users and pay research fees for it. Finish a three-to-fifteen-minute survey and you earn points. Once you reach the threshold you can withdraw to Alipay or WeChat, or spend the points on digital codes.

zh: 不需要。注册、问卷大厅、积分明细、兑换与提现均已上线，填写用户名、邮箱与密码即可开通， 不设邀请码，也不收取任何费用。没有可参与问卷时，大厅会显示空状态并说明原因。
en: No. Registration, the Survey Hall, the ledger, redemptions and payouts are all live. Just pick a username, email and password — no invite code, no fee. When nothing is available, the hall shows an empty state explaining why.

zh: 积分累计至等值十元后可申请提现，转入支付宝或微信账户； 亦可直接兑换 Steam 充值卡、游戏激活码及软件会员等数字兑换码，到账速度快于现金提现。
en: Once your points reach the equivalent of 10 CNY you can request a payout to Alipay or WeChat, or spend them directly on digital codes — Steam wallet cards, game keys, software subscriptions — which arrive faster than a cash payout.

zh: 委托方会限定样本条件，包括年龄段、城市、职业或特定产品的使用频率。名额满额或条件不符时， 问卷将无法进入。该限制由调研需求决定，与账户状态无关。
en: Clients set the sample criteria: age range, city, occupation, or how often you use a particular product. When a quota is full or you do not match, the survey cannot be entered. That limit comes from the research brief, not from your account status.

zh: 使用邮箱完成注册，耗时约三十秒。填写年龄段、所在城市与职业等基础信息， 用于匹配符合条件的问卷。上述信息仅用于样本筛选，不作商业用途。
en: Sign up with an email — it takes about thirty seconds. Add your age range, city and occupation so we can match you to surveys that fit. That information is used only for sample screening, never for marketing.

zh: 平台不设邀请码。注册完成后即可浏览全部问卷，积分于答卷审核通过后即时入账； 等级与天梯榜仅用于展示活跃度，不影响参与资格与问卷单价。
en: There is no invite code. Once registered you can browse every survey, and points are credited as soon as a response passes review. Levels and the leaderboard only show activity — they do not affect eligibility or survey prices.

zh: 积分累计至等值十元后即可提交申请。审核通过后七个工作日内到账， 处理记录可在「积分明细」中查询。提现账户须与注册人实名信息一致。
en: You can apply once your points reach the equivalent of 10 CNY. Approved payouts arrive within seven business days, and the record appears in your ledger. The receiving account must match your registered identity.

zh: 问卷列表标注题目类型、预计耗时与积分额度。中途退出不计入积分， 内容明显失真的答卷将判定无效。建议确认时间充裕后再开始作答。
en: The list shows question type, expected time and reward. Quitting halfway earns nothing, and responses that are clearly unreliable are invalidated. Make sure you have time before you start.

zh: 不计入积分。问卷按完成状态结算，中途退出视为该份样本作废，委托方亦不会为不完整的答卷付费。 建议确认时间充裕后再开始作答。
en: Nothing is earned. Surveys settle on completion — quitting voids the sample, and the client does not pay for an incomplete response. Make sure you have time before you start.

zh: 委托方获取的是脱敏统计结果与匿名答卷，不包含手机号、邮箱及真实姓名。 平台不会向第三方出售联系方式，亦不会用于商业推广。
en: Clients receive aggregated statistics and anonymous responses only — no phone numbers, emails or real names. We never sell contact details to third parties and never use them for marketing.

zh: 平台收益来源于委托方支付的调研费用。委托方提出调研需求，平台负责问卷分发与数据回收， 参与者按完成情况获得相应报酬。
en: The platform earns from research fees paid by clients. Clients bring the brief, we handle distribution and data collection, and participants are paid according to what they complete.

zh: 乘法是一个问卷积分平台。用户注册后可参与市场调研问卷，按完成情况获取积分，积分支持提现至支付宝或微信，亦可兑换数字兑换码。
en: Chengfa is a survey rewards platform. Sign up, take part in market research surveys, and earn points for completing them. Points can be withdrawn to Alipay or WeChat, or spent on digital gift codes.

zh: 积分可自由选择用途。既可按等值金额提现，亦可兑换指定平台的数字兑换码， 两种方式所占积分比例一致。
en: Points are yours to use either way: withdraw at face value, or spend them on digital codes for the platforms listed. Both routes use the same conversion rate.

zh: 同一自然人重复注册、使用脚本作答或提交明显失真的答卷，均判定无效并扣回相应积分。该规则用于保障正常参与者的样本价值。
en: Duplicate accounts, scripted responses and clearly unreliable answers are all invalidated with points clawed back. The rule protects the sample value that honest participants provide.

zh: 提供 Steam 充值卡、游戏激活码及常用软件年费会员。兑换后即时发放兑换码， 无需审核等待。
en: Steam wallet cards, game keys and annual software subscriptions. Codes are issued the moment you redeem — no review queue.

zh: 问卷类平台的主要争议通常集中在结算环节。以下四项为平台运行的基本标准，全部公开可查。
en: Most disputes around survey platforms come down to settlement. These four points are the standards we run on, all open for inspection.

zh: 申请后七个工作日内到账，处理进度可在积分明细中查询，不存在长期滞留的审核状态。
en: Payouts arrive within seven business days of the request, progress is visible in the ledger, and nothing sits in review for weeks.

zh: 注册、参与问卷及提现均不收取任何费用。凡要求预先付款的任务均与平台无关。
en: Registration, taking surveys and withdrawing are all free. Any task that asks you to pay upfront has nothing to do with this platform.

zh: 答卷以脱敏统计形式提交委托方，不包含手机号、邮箱及真实姓名等身份信息。
en: Responses reach the client as aggregated statistics, with no phone number, email or real name attached.

zh: 面向用户的问卷积分平台。参与调研获取积分，积分可提现或兑换数字兑换码。
en: A survey rewards platform for users. Take research surveys, earn points, then withdraw or redeem them for digital codes.

zh: 本站为个人独立项目，问卷数据仅交委托方用于研究统计。
en: This is an independent personal project. Survey data goes only to the client, for research statistics.

zh: 注册免费 · 无需绑定银行卡 · 支持随时注销账户
en: Free to join · No bank card needed · Close your account anytime

zh: 注册即开通账户，无需邀请码，不收取任何费用。
en: Signing up opens your account immediately — no invite code, no fees.

en: One valid sample costs less than one internal meeting.

en: Take part in market research and earn points you can actually spend.
